title: Sourcing Inquiry
description: Sourcing inquiry submitted by an overseas buyer. Linked to a guest User record for CRM tracking.

country.description: Country or primary market of the buyer.

productType.description: Short description of the product to be sourced.

quantity.description: Estimated order quantity (free text to allow units, ranges, or MOQ).

message.description: Project details, target specs, timeline, and any other context the inquirer wants to share.

sourcePage.description: Path of the page where the inquiry was submitted (for attribution).

userId.description: Reference to the guest User record that submitted this inquiry.
